title: John Mearsheimer: Israel-Palestine, Russia-Ukraine, China, NATO, and WW3 | Lex Fridman Podcast #401
summary: A three-and-a-half-hour Lex Fridman interview with international relations scholar John Mearsheimer. He discusses war and power politics, covering Israel-Palestine, Russia-Ukraine, China, NATO, and the risk of a larger war.
why: HN commenters cite it as a representative statement of Mearsheimer's realist views, such as anarchy among nation-states and Russia seeking early peace talks.
